:root{color-scheme:dark;--bg:#07110c;--panel:#0f2016;--panel2:#13271b;--line:#294333;--accent:#a3dd9e;--text:#e9f1e7;--muted:#91a393;--shadow:0 12px 36px #0003} body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 50% at 52% -8%,#183725 0%,transparent 80%),#07110c} 60px}.viewhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:18px;margin:25px 0}.viewhead h2{font-size:29px;letter-spacing:-1px;font-weight:600;margin:17px 0 iframe{border:0;flex:1;width:100%;background:#fff}.browsermsg{padding:9px 16px;color:#bdd4bf;font-size:12px;background:#12251a;border-top:1px solid #2c4231} .hidden{display:none!important}.toast{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;max-width:min(400px,90vw);padding:13px 16px;border-radius:10px;background:#223d2a;border:1px solid #648469;color:#f3f9ed;box-shadow:var(--shadow);z-index:20;font-size:13px}.foot{color:#647d6b;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;margin:78px 0 0} /* Goop: simple, compact home layout */ body{background:#0b120e} .top{height:68px;background:#0e1711;border-color:#26392b} .brand{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.8px;gap:0}.logo-dot{display:none} .home{width:min(100% - 42px,950px);padding:105px 0 70px} h1{font-size:clamp(64px,9vw,92px);font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-4.5px;margin:0 0 30px;color:#e7f5e8} .searchrow{width:min(660px,100%);border-radius:12px;background:#17221b;border:1px solid #38513e;box-shadow:none;padding:5px} .searchrow input{font-size:15px;padding:13px 16px}.searchrow .primary{font-size:13px} .sectionheading{margin:46px 0 14px}.sectionheading h2{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.4px} .bookmarks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;min-height:0} .bookmark{background:#122018;border:1px solid #293e30;border-radius:10px;min-height:54px;padding:10px 12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;text-align:left;font-weight:500;font-size:13px;min-width:0} .bookmark>button:first-child{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;text-align:left;min-width:0;font-weight:500} .bookmark .remove{color:#7d9a83;flex-shrink:0;font-size:20px}.bookmark:hover{border-color:#668972;background:#192c20} .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px} .tile{min-height:76px;padding:17px 16px;background:#122018;border-radius:11px;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-color:#293e30;transform:none!important} .tile:hover{background:#1a2d21;border-color:#668972}.tile .name{margin:0;font-size:13px;font-weight:550}.tile .detail,.tile .emoji{display:none}.tile-arrow{color:#89a793;font-size:23px;font-weight:300;line-height:1} .btn{border-radius:9px}.smallbtn{font-size:12px} .poster{font-size:0}.poster:empty:after{content:' ';display:block;width:32px;height:32px;border:1px solid #42674b;border-radius:8px;transform:rotate(-8deg)} @media(max-width:760px){.home{padding-top:87px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.bookmarks{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.tile{min-height:68px}.topright .btn{font-size:12px}}
/* Glitch + neon refresh */ :root{ --bg:#07110c; --bg2:#0a1510; --panel:#102018; --panelHi:#16291f; --line:#2f4736; --line2:#476a52; --glow:rgba(132,255,166,.14); --glow-strong:rgba(132,255,166,.28); --text:#eef7ef; } body{ position:relative; background: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%, rgba(96,255,139,.08), transparent 28%), radial-gradient(circle at 82% 16%, rgba(70,220,120,.07), transparent 25%), linear-gradient(180deg, #0a130f 0%, #06100b 100%) !important; overflow-x:hidden; } body::before, body::after{ content:""; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; } body::before{ opacity:.3; background: repeating-linear-gradient( 180deg, rgba(102,255,145,.04) 0px, rgba(102,255,145,.04) 1px, transparent 2px, transparent 4px ), linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(104,255,152,.05) 48%, transparent 50%, transparent 100%); animation:scanFloat 13s linear infinite; } body::after{ opacity:.12; mix-blend-mode:screen; background: linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 0 8%, rgba(124,255,157,.7) 8.15% 8.35%, transparent 8.5% 16%, rgba(124,255,157,.35) 16.1% 16.25%, transparent 16.3% 100%); animation:glitchSweep 9s steps(1,end) infinite; } .shell,.top,.home,.panelview,.browser{position:relative;z-index:1} @keyframes scanFloat{ 0%{transform:translateY(0)} 100%{transform:translateY(18px)} } @keyframes glitchSweep{ 0%, 87%, 100%{transform:translateX(0);opacity:.08} 88%{transform:translateX(-2px);opacity:.16} 89%{transform:translateX(2px);opacity:.1} 90%{transform:translateX(-1px);opacity:.14} 91%{transform:translateX(1px);opacity:.1} } .top{ background:rgba(9,20,14,.84)!important; backdrop-filter:blur(12px); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.18), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(120,255,157,.05); } .brand{ color:#eff8ef; text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(129,255,161,.08); } h1{ text-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(122,255,153,.12); } .searchrow{ background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(21,35,27,.96), rgba(16,28,22,.96))!important; border-color:#45644d!important; box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.28), 0 0 0 1px rgba(136,255,165,.04), 0 0 36px rgba(100,255,143,.07); } .searchrow:focus-within{ border-color:#6f9f79!important; box-shadow: 0 18px 52px rgba(0,0,0,.32), 0 0 0 1px rgba(160,255,182,.08), 0 0 44px rgba(112,255,149,.14); } .searchrow input{ color:#f3fbf4; } .btn,.iconbtn,.bookmark,.tile,.result,.settinggroup,.field,.browserbar input{ box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02) inset, 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.16); } .btn,.iconbtn{ background:linear-gradient(180deg,#16281e,#13241b)!important; border-color:#35503d!important; } .btn:hover,.iconbtn:hover{ background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1c3426,#183023)!important; border-color:#6b9174!important; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(148,255,175,.04),0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22),0 0 20px rgba(91,255,139,.08); } .btn.primary{ background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b6efb0,#98dda1)!important; color:#102015!important; border-color:#bdeeb9!important; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18),0 0 18px rgba(138,255,166,.16); } .bookmark, .tile, .result, .settinggroup{ background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18,32,24,.94), rgba(14,25,19,.96))!important; border-color:#314937!important; } .bookmark:hover, .tile:hover, .result:hover{ border-color:#749a7e!important; box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.22), 0 0 18px rgba(100,255,143,.08); } .tile-arrow, .bookmark .remove{ color:#9ccdaa!important; } .poster{ background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1f3828,#173021)!important; } .poster:empty:after{ border-color:#5a8d67!important; box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(109,255,152,.1); } .browserbar{ background:rgba(12,25,17,.92)!important; backdrop-filter:blur(10px); } .browsermsg{ color:#cfe8d4!important; background:#12241a!important; } .notice{ border-color:#56795f!important; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(21,42,29,.94), rgba(17,32,23,.96))!important; }
/* Goop Matrix rain — decorative canvas behind fully usable page */ #matrixRain { position:fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; z-index:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.78; } body { background:#030a05 !important; } body::before { z-index:0; opacity:1; transform:none !important; animation:none !important; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 42% at 50% 24%, rgba(0,0,0,.25), rgba(0,0,0,.53) 85%, rgba(0,0,0,.70)), linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(2,9,4,.08), rgba(1,7,3,.28)); } body::after { z-index:0; opacity:.17; animation:glitchSweep 9s steps(1,end) infinite; } .shell { position:relative; z-index:1; } .home { padding-top:clamp(88px,13vh,140px); } .matrix-title { position:relative; display:table; margin:0 auto 33px; font-family:Lexend,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:clamp(78px,12vw,140px); font-weight:800; line-height:1.13; letter-spacing:-.075em; padding-right:.075em; color:#b5ffb7; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(206,255,204,.94) 0px 2px, rgba(33,146,58,.66) 3px 5px, rgba(137,255,157,.95) 6px 9px), linear-gradient(180deg,#d4ffcf,#42d66c 64%,#075421); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(60,255,109,.6)) drop-shadow(0 0 27px rgba(37,255,94,.28)); animation:matrixTitleFlash 8s steps(1,end) infinite; } .matrix-title::before { content:attr(data-text); position:absolute; inset:0; color:#24fe63; -webkit-text-fill-color:#24fe63; opacity:.17; transform:translate(2px,0); clip-path:inset(35% 0 59% 0); animation:matrixTitleGlitch 7s steps(1,end) infinite; pointer-events:none; } .matrix-title::after { content:attr(data-text); position:absolute; inset:0; color:#e3ffe1; -webkit-text-fill-color:#e3ffe1; opacity:.13; transform:translate(-2px,0); clip-path:inset(69% 0 27% 0); animation:matrixTitleGlitch2 9s steps(1,end) infinite; pointer-events:none; } @keyframes matrixTitleFlash { 0%,94%,96%,100%{opacity:1} 95%{opacity:.86} } @keyframes matrixTitleGlitch { 0%,91%,94%,100%{transform:translate(2px,0);opacity:0} 92%{transform:translate(8px,0);opacity:.48} 93%{transform:translate(-4px,0);opacity:.24} } @keyframes matrixTitleGlitch2 { 0%,82%,85%,100%{transform:translate(-2px,0);opacity:0} 83%{transform:translate(-7px,0);opacity:.42} 84%{transform:translate(5px,0);opacity:.2} } .searchrow, .bookmark, .tile, .result, .settinggroup { backdrop-filter:blur(9px); } .searchrow {background:rgba(9,28,14,.88) !important;border-color:#457b4e !important} .bookmark, .tile, .result, .settinggroup { background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,26,14,.91),rgba(6,18,10,.94)) !important; } .top {background:rgba(5,17,8,.89) !important} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .matrix-title,.matrix-title::before,.matrix-title::after,body::after{animation:none!important} .matrix-title::before,.matrix-title::after{opacity:0!important} }
/* Intentionally bright, self-contained binary background — no external GIF. */ #matrixRain{ position:fixed !important; inset:0 !important; width:100vw !important; height:100vh !important; z-index:0 !important; pointer-events:none !important; opacity:1 !important; filter:none !important; } body::before{ content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none; opacity:1 !important;animation:none !important;transform:none !important; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 36%, rgba(0,9,3,.26) 0%,rgba(0,9,3,.12) 40%,rgba(0,8,3,.45) 100%) !important; } body::after{display:none !important} body{background:#010802 !important;} .shell{position:relative;z-index:1} .home{background:transparent} .top{background:rgba(2,14,6,.85)!important} .searchrow{background:rgba(5,21,10,.92)!important} .tile,.bookmark,.result,.settinggroup{background:rgba(5,19,10,.89)!important} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#matrixRain{opacity:1!important}}
/* Binary background using real text; visible even before JavaScript loads. */ body{background:#010802!important;isolation:isolate} body::before,body::after{display:none!important} #matrixRain,#binaryGif{display:none!important} #binaryBackdrop{ position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;overflow:hidden; background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 50% 28%,#021406 0%,#010903 63%,#000601 100%); pointer-events:none; } #binaryBackdrop::after{ content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none; background:radial-gradient(ellipse 65% 55% at 50% 46%,transparent 18%,rgba(0,4,0,.3) 100%); } .binary-column{ position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:-70vh; display:block;white-space:pre;text-align:center; color:#47ff67;font:700 19px/23px monospace; opacity:var(--brightness); text-shadow:0 0 8px #14ff46,0 0 21px rgba(7,255,63,.65); transform:translateY(var(--offset)); animation:binaryDrift var(--speed) linear var(--delay) infinite; will-change:transform; } .binary-column:nth-child(4n){color:#a5ffad;text-shadow:0 0 10px #77ff85,0 0 25px rgba(37,255,67,.65)} .binary-column:nth-child(3n){font-size:17px;line-height:25px;opacity:calc(var(--brightness)*.7)} @keyframes binaryDrift{from{transform:translateY(-60vh)}to{transform:translateY(110vh)}} .shell{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important} .top{background:rgba(0,13,4,.9)!important} .searchrow{background:rgba(2,17,6,.94)!important} .bookmark,.tile,.result,.settinggroup{background:rgba(3,18,7,.93)!important} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.binary-column{animation:none!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}}
/* Calm Matrix effect: gentle vertical scrolling, no strobing. */ .binary-column{ animation-name:goopSlowBinary !important; animation-duration:var(--calm-speed, 30s) !important; animation-timing-function:linear !important; animation-iteration-count:infinite !important; text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(53,255,100,.65),0 0 14px rgba(31,203,72,.24) !important; } .binary-column:nth-child(4n){text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(145,255,160,.6),0 0 16px rgba(33,233,87,.22)!important} @keyframes goopSlowBinary{ from{transform:translate3d(0,-35vh,0)} to{transform:translate3d(0,100vh,0)} } /* Distinct moderate-speed bands create visibly moving but calm code rain. */ .binary-column:nth-child(5n+1){--calm-speed:27s} .binary-column:nth-child(5n+2){--calm-speed:31s} .binary-column:nth-child(5n+3){--calm-speed:35s} .binary-column:nth-child(5n+4){--calm-speed:39s} .binary-column:nth-child(5n){--calm-speed:43s} /* Reduce distraction: keep the Goop title continuously illuminated. */ .matrix-title,.matrix-title::before,.matrix-title::after{animation:none!important} .matrix-title::before,.matrix-title::after{opacity:0!important} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){ .binary-column{animation:none!important;transform:translateY(var(--offset))!important} }
/* Visible, seamless Matrix binary motion, no JS / no external assets */ #binaryBackdrop,#matrixRain,#binaryGif{display:none!important} #goopBinaryRain{ position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;overflow:hidden!important; z-index:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;display:block!important; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,#001c08 0%,#000c04 65%,#000701 100%); } .goop-rain-column{ position:absolute;display:block;top:-1628px;left:var(--x); white-space:pre;text-align:center;font:600 18px/22px monospace; color:#42ff74;opacity:var(--bright); text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(23,255,73,.75),0 0 20px rgba(8,201,45,.35); will-change:transform; animation:goopFall var(--duration) linear var(--lag) infinite !important; animation-play-state:running!important; } .goop-rain-column:nth-child(4n){color:#8bffa0} @keyframes goopFall{from{transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:translate3d(0,1628px,0)}} .shell{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important} .top{background:rgba(0,11,4,.88)!important} .searchrow{background:rgba(2,18,7,.93)!important} .tile,.bookmark,.result,.settinggroup{background:rgba(3,19,8,.92)!important} /* Reducing motion is handled with a user-controlled toggle instead of stopping it invisibly. */ body.goop-motion-off .goop-rain-column{animation:none!important;transform:translate3d(0,800px,0)!important} @media(max-width:650px){.goop-rain-column{font-size:15px;line-height:22px}}
/* Calm Matrix: dim, sparse rain that moves in the distance */ #goopBinaryRain{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#020b05,#06150a 55%,#020b05)!important} .goop-rain-column{ color:#65e985!important; opacity:calc(var(--bright) * .46)!important; font-weight:400!important; text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(55,215,87,.35)!important; animation-timing-function:linear!important; } .goop-rain-column:nth-child(3n){opacity:calc(var(--bright) * .13)!important} .goop-rain-column:nth-child(7n){display:none!important} /* Fixed vignette: brighter in the edges, subdued behind the search */ #goopBinaryRain::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 32%,rgba(0,8,2,.62),rgba(0,9,3,.12) 76%)} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.goop-rain-column{animation:none!important}}
/* Reliable, medium-speed binary movement. */ #goopBinaryRain .goop-rain-column { animation: goopVisibleFall var(--duration2, 19s) linear var(--lag2, 0s) infinite !important; animation-play-state:running !important; opacity: calc(var(--bright) * .65) !important; color:#83fca0 !important; text-shadow:0 0 7px rgba(55,255,99,.55) !important; } #goopBinaryRain .goop-rain-column:nth-child(3n){ opacity:calc(var(--bright) * .42) !important; } #goopBinaryRain .goop-rain-column:nth-child(7n){ display:block !important; opacity:calc(var(--bright) * .20) !important; } @keyframes goopVisibleFall { from {transform:translate3d(0,0,0)} to {transform:translate3d(0,1628px,0)} } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { #goopBinaryRain .goop-rain-column { animation:goopVisibleFall var(--duration2,19s) linear var(--lag2,0s) infinite !important; } } body.goop-motion-off #goopBinaryRain .goop-rain-column { animation:none !important; transform:translate3d(0,800px,0) !important; }
/* In-page search fallback when no Scramjet proxy is installed */ .browser{position:relative}.search-fallback{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:26px max(20px,calc((100% - 920px)/2));background:rgba(3,14,7,.97);color:#e4f5e8} .search-fallback h2{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.6px;margin:4px 0 9px} .search-fallback p{color:#a8c4ae;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65} .search-fallback .search-result{display:block;width:100%;padding:18px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #244331;background:none;text-align:left;color:inherit;cursor:pointer} .search-fallback .search-result strong{font-size:16px;color:#a1efb1;font-weight:550} .search-fallback .search-result span{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:12px;color:#a8bfb0;line-height:1.6} .search-fallback .search-result:hover strong{text-decoration:underline} .search-fallback .search-panel{border:1px solid #315b3c;background:#0a2111;border-radius:12px;padding:18px;margin:15px 0} .search-fallback .btn{margin-top:10px}
/* Layout repair — no enormous invisible overlay and no clipped dashboard */ html,body{height:auto!important;min-height:100%!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overflow-y:auto!important;} #goopBinaryRain{position:fixed!important;top:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;left:0!important;width:100vw!important;height:100dvh!important;max-height:100dvh!important;overflow:hidden!important;z-index:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;} .shell{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;isolation:isolate;min-height:100dvh!important;overflow:visible!important;} .top{z-index:5!important;flex-shrink:0} .home{display:block;width:min(1040px,calc(100% - 36px))!important;padding:clamp(30px,6vh,60px) 0 64px!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0 auto!important;overflow:visible!important} .home .matrix-title{font-size:clamp(66px,10vw,114px)!important;margin:0 auto clamp(14px,3vh,26px)!important} .home .sectionheading{margin:clamp(20px,3vh,30px) 0 12px!important} .home .bookmarks{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(145px,1fr))!important;gap:10px!important;min-height:56px} .home .grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:11px!important;visibility:visible!important} .home .tile{min-height:64px!important;visibility:visible!important} .home .bookmark{visibility:visible!important} .browser{height:calc(100dvh - 68px)!important;min-height:300px} .browser iframe{min-height:0;display:block} @media(max-width:640px){.home{padding-top:36px!important}.home .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}.home .bookmarks{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}}
/* Search engine status stays accessible even if the target website refuses iframe embedding. */ #searchGuide{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap; background:rgba(9,28,14,.96);border-bottom:1px solid #41634a;padding:10px 15px; color:#c8e4ce;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55} #searchGuide a{color:#b7ffc2;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px} #searchGuide button{background:#254331;color:#e6f8e7;border:1px solid #54745d;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 9px} #searchGuide.hidden{display:none}
